authority_hierarchy.5: Level 5: Primary Authoritative (Acts, Rules, Treaties, First Schedule 56 Books, Gazette Notifications, Final Case Law Precedents)

authority_hierarchy.1: Level 1: Discovery Context Only (News, trade articles)
